title: Line items
description: The things billed, one per row, in the order they are printed.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: How many units: hours, items or days. Fractions such as 2.5 are allowed.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What one unit is, such as hour or day, printed after the unit price, as in 95.00 / hour.

unit_price.title: Unit price
unit_price.description: The price of one unit in the invoice's currency, to the cent. A negative price is a discount.
